description.value: Xenia Centre is a 38-acre nature sanctuary on Bowen Island celebrating over 30 years of land stewardship, offering unique wooden cottages surrounded by old-growth forest and protected government lands. The centre specialises in healing, creativity, and personal transformation retreats, reachable by BC Ferry from Horseshoe Bay or by seaplane. It is a quiet, contemplative destination well off the beaten tourist track.

address.value: 782 Smith Road, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2
